description: On the table in front of you are a red plastic cup, a bunch of purple grapes, a small rectangular block, and a thin yellow stick lying near the center. The left hand stays mostly still near the bottom, while the right hand reaches in to grasp the yellow stick as a right-hand object, lifts it up and forward to the cup, dips the tip into the cup briefly, then pulls it back out and releases it near where it started.
